title: Concept: Set-Cookie Max-Age is not a valid integer
description: A Max-Age value a user agent cannot parse is discarded, so the cookie persists for a different lifetime than the header appears to declare.
applicability: Responses that set a cookie with a Max-Age attribute.
risk: A credential outlives the window the deployment meant to set, or dies at browser close when persistence was intended; LOW because the effect is a lifetime mismatch rather than direct exposure.
